core_obligations: Use the specialization from a point over the generic point and the unibranch hypothesis to analyse the local structure.
Conclude flatness, and hence etaleness, from unramifiedness together with flatness.

proof_roadmap.step: Use the specialization and unibranchness at the image point.
Derive flatness at the given point.

difficulty_reason: For a locally finite type morphism over an integral base that is geometrically unibranch at the image point, if there is a specialization from a point lying over the generic point of the base to the given point and the morphism is unramified there, then it is etale there. The proof uses the unibranch hypothesis to control the local structure along the specialization and concludes flatness from unramifiedness plus the dominance condition, giving etaleness. Deriving flatness from the specialization and unibranchness is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10479-10493.
